content.comment_body: Hello Expert, I am looking to receive analog signals (4-20mA) from my sensors through a MOXA IOLOGIK E1240. Is this supported? Thank you.

Yes, this can be done. The MOXA E1240 manual states it supports Modbus TCP and can function as a slave device. The controller would act as the master, but you need to use [product_name] with [version_no] since only that version supports Modbus TCP/IP.
